_schema: qa/typed/review.json v1: human certification of decision-model gold labels. status=reviewed requires EVERY scenario in the label source covered by a style/choice entry whose labels_sha256 matches the source bytes, with reviewer named and rationale_ok true. coverage_ack.{qid} lists per-criterion acknowledgments {criterion, reviewer, note, source_sha256} for train-uncovered criteria (R7); any label-source edit voids coverage for the changed bytes (re-review and re-record the sha). Choice entries use {scenario_id, label, reviewer, label_ok, source_sha256} against choice.jsonl bytes (R8 advisory). clm_calibrate.py refuses to recommend a floor until this ledger certifies derive_style_labels.py.
